# Cuemath

> Cuemath is an online math tutoring platform offering K-12 personalized 1-on-1 classes with certified tutors, gamified learning, and curriculum-aligned content.

Cuemath provides comprehensive math education through interactive live classes, worksheets, and games designed to make learning engaging and effective. The platform covers elementary through high school mathematics, including specialized test prep for standardized assessments like STAAR and NJSLA.

## Key Topics

- Online tutoring
- 1-on-1 personalized classes
- Gamified learning platform
- Certified math tutors
- K-12 math education
- Live interactive classes
- Math worksheets and practice
- Elementary math
- Algebra and Geometry
- AP Calculus and Precalculus
- Test prep (STAAR, NJSLA)
- Curriculum-aligned content
- Math problem-solving
- Personalized learning paths
- Gamified assessments
